verdict.rationale: Evidence shows Auth0 offers a CLI (auth0-cli) and an official MCP server that lets AI agents 'create applications, managing users, or deploying Actions... all without touching the dashboard' (auth0-gh-1, auth0-docs-41, auth0-probe-5), indicating substantial UI/API parity for core admin tasks. However, the evidence pack lacks explicit documentation of a comprehensive Management API covering every dashboard feature, and a probe for a discoverable OpenAPI/swagger spec returned 404 on all checked paths (auth0-probe-3), leaving unclear how complete API parity is for advanced dashboard-only settings. Missing for 10: explicit Management API reference docs, evidence of full parity for all dashboard features, and a working machine-readable API spec.
